An unfinished masterwork ranged draft for the chaps must first be created at the pattern table, consuming all of the items, after which it can be worked on via the tailoring process to create it. Crafting this item requires a total of 30,000 progress; 9,000 at the drafting table (as an unfinished masterwork ranged draft) and 21,000 at the tailor's dummy (as an unfinished masterwork ranged chaps). At the default rate of 20 progress every 4 ticks (2.4 seconds), this takes 6000 ticks, or 60 minutes. This time may be increased or decreased by interacting with focus windows.
